New TVS iQube With Android Auto Debuts At EICMA 2026

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • TVS Motor set up a grand pavilion at EICMA 2026 in Milan, Italy and at this stage, the company announced their portfolio for Europe.
  • The electric lineup included M1S, which will first launch in Indonesia and then in Europe, followed by TVS X, and then Orbiter.
  • Official reporting verified via Rushlane.com news desk.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

TVS Motor set up a grand pavilion at EICMA 2026 in Milan, Italy and at this stage, the company announced their portfolio for Europe. The electric lineup included M1S, which will first launch in Indonesia and then in Europe, followed by TVS X, and then Orbiter. Making some noise on the stage was the unveiling of TVS RTR 125 which stole the show, basically.

📌 The Core Development

However, at the same stage, TVS Motor announced something in a passing glance and was even displayed on the screen for just a short while, which grabbed our attention. That is the announcement that TVS iQube electric scooter will soon get Android Auto, in partnership with Google.

Currently, top variants of iQube get a 7-inch touchscreen that supports a host of connected attributes and smart features. This touchscreen will now support Android Auto for the first time. It will be the same Android Auto interface that we are familiar with in cars and the 7-inch screen real estate should not pose any limitations, where size is concerned.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

TVS Motor announced that they have partnered with Google to offer Android Auto connected feature with their popular iQube scooter. The same cluster also shows vehicular details too. These include battery SOC, range computer, trip computer, speedo clock and more. There are tell-tale signs integrated in the same display too.

It has to be noted that TVS Motor has worked with Google before and TVS X for India already gets wireless Android Auto integration in its 10.2-inch TFT instrument cluster. Same feature will also be offered with the TVS X for European market as confirmed by the company on the same stage.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

With Android Auto, users will now be able to access the same apps from their phone instead of using proprietary apps to get things done. The company did not explain whether the connection is wireless or wired. Also, there was no announcement whether this feature will be offered starting now with new buyers or can be unlocked to existing customers as well.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

There was no announcement of Apple CarPlay with iQube yet. It makes sense for TVS Motor to just stick with Android Auto owing to the sheer proportion of Android user base in India, as opposed to iPhones.
